function.name: lookup_history
function.description: Look up past results in the snapshot, latest first. For player and team queries supply the exact current player or team names; optionally filter champion. For series use its exact identifier. Each entity returns a separate summary and most recent observations. All side-relative statistics refer to that entity's team; series rows refer to blue.

messages.content: You are forecasting a League of Legends game at the indicated observation point. Use only the supplied current facts, the frozen history lookup, and general LoL knowledge. Do not use or recall results of the target or later games. Query the starters' personal history and any relevant past teams/series before predicting. Evaluate side, sample size, and available draft information. Return only a JSON object with p_blue_win and p_blue_ahead_15 (strict gold lead at 15:00). Both numbers must be probabilities.
